criteria.criterion: s3_doctor._git routes through gitutil.run_git_write; no raw run_git call remains in s3_doctor.
The proven `bad object` signature is retried by the existing transient-read wrapper in gitutil, scoped to that marker family — no new retry loop is introduced.

A test injects the transient deterministically (first bundle attempt fails with the exact CI signature, the identical retry succeeds) and asserts the heal completes losslessly. It fails before the change.
A non-transient git failure is still raised immediately, with no retry — pinned by a test, so the marker cannot mask a genuine error.
A bundle failure that survives the retries raises an error whose hint describes an object-DB read failure rather than a heads conflict.
